name: formify-track-signatures
title_zh: 签名发出后谁签了、谁没签、怎么催怎么撤
tagline_zh: 文档发出去三天没人回，你只想问一句「谁签了」——它直接列出每个收件人的状态，还能只催没签的那个、改错邮箱。
tagline_en: Sent a doc for signature and it went quiet? See per-recipient status, nudge only the ones who haven't signed, fix.
desc_en: Track who has signed, remind them, fix a recipient or cancel a send. Use after a document went out for signature and has not come back, when contact details were wrong, or when the signed copy is needed. Triggers on "who has signed", "send a reminder", "wrong email address", "cancel the signing", "revoke a document", "download the signed copy", "vem har signerat", "påminnelse", "återkalla", "quién
why_zh: 它盯的是「发出之后」这一段：按收件人粒度区分已签/未签/已送达，提醒只发给卡住的人。
why_en: It owns the post-send window: per-recipient signed/pending/delivered status, reminders that only hit the stuck ones, email fixes.
limit_zh: 只管已经发出去的签名请求，不能新建或编辑文档内容；撤销是整单作废、不能只撤某一个收件人；改邮箱只对未签的人生效。
limit_en: Only handles already-sent signature requests; can't create or edit the document. Cancel voids the whole request, not one recipient. Email fixes.
title_en: Track, remind, fix, or cancel a sent signature request
